decisions.reason: Making the SDA/SCL series damping resistors optional does not change the interboard signal connector selection or pinout.
The source decision concerns I2C signal conditioning and does not change the separate interboard power connector or its pin-order rule.
The source changes passive conditioning on SDA/SCL but does not remap any ESP32-S3 GPIO.
The USB D+ and D- programming interface is independent of the SDA/SCL series-resistor policy.
The resistor references overlap only incidentally; the source concerns I2C damping resistors, not the charge-status LED resistor or output.
The standalone 3.3V supply continues to power the listed I2C devices; optional SDA/SCL damping does not change its regulator, activation, loads, or source selection.
The addressable LED power, level shifting, and shutdown behavior are unrelated to I2C SDA/SCL conditioning.
The I2C series-resistor and cable-length decision does not alter the ESP32 sleep policy, clock behavior, or wake sources.
The source decision does not change the separate eight-LED array board or its LED count.
The sensor board remains a connector hub; the source only changes the optional population of I2C damping resistors and does not necessarily change that board role.
Allowing optional placement of specified I2C resistors does not modify the existing component-sourceability or compatible-alternative policy.
The source decision does not change the AXP2101 power-management IC, required rails, or normal battery power path.
